answers.ask: No look was stated - marble and glass hotel lobby, or something more stylized and cartoony?
answers.answer: Use a marble and glass hotel-lobby look, with the water fountain as the central focal point.

answers.ask: Is this the lobby for a game with rounds or minigames, or just a place to hang out? A round lobby usually wants teleporters and a queue area.
answers.answer: This is just a place to hang out; do not add round teleporters or a queue area.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D marble-and-glass hotel lobby designed as a social hangout space, with a water fountain as the central focal point. Arrange the lobby openly around the fountain, with no round teleporters or queue area.
agent_notes: The word lobby points at Party & Casual, but the author closed that off explicitly — this is just a place to hang out, with no round teleporters and no queue area — so no game type remains and it lands on No Genre, whose Social Space preset is modelled on exactly this kind of hangout. The marble and glass hotel lobby is one enclosed room the player never leaves, so enclosure is interior-only, which costs nothing; every other axis is at its default and the build routes P0. Social Space's three picks map straight onto the brief: the lobby floor is the gathering area, the fountain is the central focal point the author named, and the entrance is the arrival point. I treated the fountain as the landmark rather than also filing it as a water body, since it is one centrepiece and a decorative basin needs no volumetric check, and I assumed a single ground floor because no mezzanine or upper level was mentioned.
